breakdown.description: Boundary section contains incompatible boundary condition types (e.g., periodic vs Dirichlet/Neumann).
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt provided two conflicting boundary conditions: 'Simply-supported' (u=0 and Δu=0) and 'Neumann (zero-flux)' (∂u/∂n = 0). The ground truth correctly removed the conflicting Neumann condition. The agent's generated specification also correctly omitted the incorrect Neumann condition and only included the 'Simply-supported' condition, thus resolving the inconsistency.
